messages:
Ava (CSM): Quick heads up — Meridian QBR is next Thu. Need a final gap-map + enablement rundown in the slide deck. Slides due EOD Wed. Can owners confirm what they're taking?

Diego (CS Ops): I'll take the onboarding snapshot (slide 4). Will drop a draft by Tue morning.

Priya (Eng-Solutions): I'll own the risk heatmap + the exec ask slide. Need the latest renewal signal + top 3 production blockers to call out. @Samir can you paste the latest account notes?

Samir (AE): Renewal probability ~70% (last touch), primary risks: integration lag (API retries), latency spikes during peak, and limited admin enablement. Sending quick Loom and notes now: https://loom.example.com/meridian-qbr-summary

Ava (CSM): Perfect — embed the Loom in the deck under "Customer signals". Also add one-sentence recommended ask for execs (e.g., short runway + dedicated SRE time).

Diego (CS Ops): Adding enablement checklist for customer admins to slide 6. Draft checklist (will format for slides):
```
- Admin onboarding: SSO + RBAC verified
- Integrations: webhook retry config applied
- Observability: dashboards shared + alerting set
- Playbook: incident runbook shared with ops
```

Priya (Eng-Solutions): Nice checklist. For the risk slide, can we include measurable mitigation steps and owners? e.g., "Latency -> canary + perf tuning (Eng-Solutions), ETA 2 weeks"

Samir (AE): I'll add the customer commitment language and commercial ask. Also pinging the success sponsor (cc: @Elena) to confirm exec availability for the readout.

Ava (CSM): Action items so far: 
- Diego: onboarding snapshot + checklist (slide 4/6) — draft Tue
- Priya: risk heatmap + mitigation owners + canary plan — draft Tue EOD
- Samir: customer notes, Loom embed, commercial ask language — Tue
- Ava: consolidate slides + final review Wed 10:00am PT
- OpsBot: create QBR dry-run calendar invite for Wed 10:00am PT and assign slides to owners

Priya (Eng-Solutions): One more ask — can we add a short "what success looks like" slide with 2 metrics (reduced API errors by 50% and improved time-to-value for admins)? Helps with exec alignment.

Diego (CS Ops): Yep — adding a 2-metric success slide. Also including a quick checklist for the enablement session (30 min walkthrough + admin sandbox access).

Samir (AE): FYI I reached out to the sponsor; they're available Fri for pre-brief if we want it. Might be helpful to rehearse the commercial ask with them.

Ava (CSM): Good call — let's keep Friday optional. Primary dry-run Wed 10. If anyone needs to shift owners, flag here. Otherwise I'll collect final slides by Tue 5pm and do the merge.

Diego (CS Ops): All good from me.

Priya (Eng-Solutions): Confirmed.

Samir (AE): Confirmed.

Ava (CSM): Thanks team :thumbsup: — will follow up with the deck link and OpsBot invite in this thread.
